answer: Escrow 100 scarce tokens per AI key for an entire 30-day round to get one bid on jade or ferrous scrap contracts. Validators check distinct outputs bound to key and round; missing or reused bonds get no bid. n keys immobilize 100n tokens, so splitting keys cannot reuse collateral. Principal returns: the cost is locked capital, not a 100-token fee. Cheap credit weakens deterrence; wealth still buys bids. Colluding validators could accept double pledges, making the exchange a Sybil haven.
